EnableHorizontalSmoothingDescription: Enable box blur smoothing of climate map during worldgen.
EnableVerticalSmoothingDescription: Enable sigmoid curve for elevation temperature changes.
SmoothingPassesDescription: How many times to apply the blur. More passes = smoother. 1-3 recommended.
SigmoidAmplitudeDescription: Max temperature penalty at extreme heights in degrees C. Vanilla drops ~28C over 180 blocks. Examples: 12 = gentle (peaks 12C colder), 28 = vanilla-like, 35 = harsh arctic peaks.
SigmoidSteepnessDescription: How sharply temperature drops at mid-elevations (per raw block). Examples: 0.01 = very gentle curve, 0.025 = moderate (default), 0.05 = steep drop on small hills.
SigmoidInflectionDescription: Blocks above sea level where cooling rate is steepest (inflection point). Examples: 40 = cooling kicks in early, 80 = mid-range (default), 120 = only tall mountains get steep cooling.
UseClimateAwareElevationDescription: If true, hot biomes cool less on mountains (tropical peaks stay warmer), cold biomes cool more.
ClimateWeightFactorDescription: Strength of climate-aware effect. Examples: 0.01 = subtle (20C base gets 15% less cooling), 0.03 = moderate, 0.05 = strong effect.
EnableDebugLoggingDescription: Log a sample temperature transformation every 5 seconds to help diagnose issues. Prints initial vs final temperature.
